scope: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Europe 2026 residential catalogue: exact single-split column pairs (finish suffixes listed per column), casings, cooling high-fan indoor airflow, outdoor cooling airflow, nominal cooling capacity, factory refrigerant, published outdoor operating ranges, SCM connectable head counts and total indoor capacity ceilings. Combination tables, performance and PAC/VRF ranges are not imported.
method: Mechanical column readback from the pinned pdftotext -layout page text by tools/transcribe-catalogue-2026.py, plus visual comparison of each rendered page image with the extracted rows (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-23). Not a manufacturer certification; performance, compressor and coil data are not applied.
